newsitem.title: USA: Coffee People discloses acquisition terms.
newsitem.headline: Coffee People discloses acquisition terms.

text.p: Coffee People Inc on Tuesday disclosed the terms of its pending acquisition of 15 Coffee Plantation stores from a unit of The Second Cup Ltd.

In an 8-K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Coffee People said it was acquiring the Coffee Plantation locations from Canadian-based Second Cup for $8.2 million, plus the cost of inventory at closing.
Of the total price, $6 million, or about 70 percent, is being financed with proceeds from a five-year term loan from Bank of America. The balance will come from company cash reserves.
Coffee People said it would continue to have cash and cash equivalents on hand after the acquisition to capitalize on store development or acquisition opportunities.
